title: Disclosure Transition Event v2
description: Canonical append-only disclosure transition event. v2 binds stable timestamps, compilation receipt digest, retention/training assertions, and consumed authorization receipt digest in the PREPARED and AUTHORIZATION_CONSUMED states. Recovery reconstructs all downstream artifacts deterministically from the immutable plan. Lane A owns this authority surface.

transition_id.description: Stable transition identifier. Root identity for all downstream artifact identities.

evidence_digest.description: SHA256 digest of the opaque evidence object (candidate ZIP bundle).

projection_id.description: Review projection identifier. Used for manifest path and receipt construction.

disclosure_class.description: Governance disclosure class for this transition.

selector_digest.description: Protected-content selector digest for scoped disclosure.

selector_required_class.description: Manifest selector's required disclosure class for three-way match.

manifest_digest_before.description: Protected-content manifest digest before the disclosure mutation.

manifest_digest_after.description: Protected-content manifest digest after the disclosure mutation. Populated at MANIFEST_APPLIED.

provider_or_channel.description: Provider or channel for disclosure routing.

retention_assertion.description: User-asserted retention period. Bound at PREPARED for deterministic receipt reconstruction.

training_use_assertion.description: User-asserted training-use disposition. Bound at PREPARED for deterministic receipt reconstruction.

compilation_receipt_sha256.description: SHA256 of the compilation receipt file. Validated against disk at PREPARED and bound for deterministic receipt reconstruction.

receipt_approved_at.description: Stable timestamp bound at PREPARED. Used verbatim in the downstream disclosure receipt for byte-for-byte reproducibility.

disclosure_event_created_at.description: Stable timestamp bound at PREPARED. Used verbatim in the downstream disclosure event for byte-for-byte reproducibility.

consumed_auth_receipt_digest.description: SHA256 digest of the consumed governance authorization receipt. Populated at AUTHORIZATION_CONSUMED. Used during recovery to validate receipt integrity.

parent_transition_digest.description: Transition digest of the parent event in the chain. Used for integrity chains.

downstream_event_id.description: Content-light disclosure event identifier. Populated at DISCLOSURE_EVENT_RECORDED.

downstream_receipt_digest.description: Path or digest of the persisted projection receipt. Populated at PROJECTION_RECEIPT_PERSISTED.

recovery_detail.description: Human-readable recovery or error detail. Populated at recovery/refusal/corrupt transitions.

corrupt_detail.description: Detailed corruption description if status is corrupt.

transition_digest.description: SHA256 integrity digest binding all governance-significant fields at this lifecycle state.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of this event's creation.

sequence.description: Monotonic sequence number within the transition_id chain.
